name: ChatGPT / GPT-4o (OpenAI)
description: ChatGPT powered by GPT-4o is the leading conversational AI platform, offering state-of-the-art vision, voice, and real-time multimodal capabilities for consumer and enterprise workflows.

name: DeepSeek R1 / V3 (DeepSeek)
description: DeepSeek R1 is a frontier open-weights reasoning model optimized with Reinforcement Learning. It delivers high-level math, code, and logic performance at ultra-low inference costs.

name: Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash (Google)
description: Google Gemini 1.5 features a groundbreaking 2M token context window, allowing seamless ingestion of massive video, audio, and large repositories for enterprise intelligence.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic)
description: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets the standard for autonomous coding, visual reasoning, and human-like nuanced content creation, backed by interactive web Artifacts.

name: Grok 3 (xAI)
description: Grok 3 by xAI leverages real-time access to the X global real-time stream, powered by massive GPU clusters to deliver low-latency live web intelligence and code synthesis.

name: Llama 3.3 70B (Meta)
description: Meta Llama 3.3 is the flagship open-weight 70B parameter LLM offering state-of-the-art inference efficiency for self-hosted enterprise infrastructure and custom fine-tuning.

name: Cursor AI (Anysphere)
description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor built as a VS Code fork. Its Composer agent enables developers to write multi-file features and fix bugs through conversational natural language.
